responsibility: Implements generic CFG analysis utilities that are shared across GCC middle-end and backend passes. This file computes reachability and DFS backedges, builds dense edge-index lists for dataflow clients, derives traversal and predecessor/successor set operations, supports dominance-frontier and iterated-dominance-frontier style computations, and offers helper orderings and predicates such as single-predecessor queries that ignore loop backedges; it consumes the generic CFG and dominance information and produces analysis views used by SSA, loop, and optimization passes.
same_name_distinction: Implements the generic CFG analyses and traversals such as DFS/backedge marking, unreachable-block discovery, edge-list construction, dominance-frontier helpers, and predecessor/successor bitmap operations; unlike gcc/cfganal.h, which only defines helper types and declares those analysis entry points.
